provider: U.S. DOT National Transportation Library ROSA P
operation: targeted full-text reassessment of an existing report
note: Retains the historical title/source screen and identifies a supplementary research safety observation in the official full text.

records.title: Low Flow / Optimized Flow Oxygen Systems for Passengers – (OFOS) - A Physiologic Inquiry into Emergency Supplemental Oxygen Supply Needs and Procedures
records.source_locator: Technical report documentation p. iii and printed pp. 6, 12, 17-18, 20, 27 and 32 (PDF pp. 3, 13, 19, 24-25, 27, 34 and 39)
records.role_review: Supplementary research safety from a passenger oxygen-mask experiment. Research participants and inside observers do not constitute operational staff and trainee risk sets.

reassessment.locator: Printed pp. 6 and 20 (roles and sessions), 17 and 32 (DCS monitoring and safety statement)

session_flow.role_exposures_basis: Derived from 12 completed profiles and one participant plus one inside observer per flight (printed pp. 6 and 20). Observers could repeat, and the report gives no unique observer count.
abort_and_rescheduling: Two ear blocks. Neither participant returned. The report does not give their exact abort altitude or phase.
One intestinal gas-expansion pain episode on ascent. The participant returned for a rescheduled session and completed the profile.

One aviator-mask seal failure. The methods call for seal verification before proceeding, but the report does not document the altitude or phase of the actual failed attempt. The participant returned for a rescheduled session and completed the profile.
session_flow.scope_note: The 16 sessions include four aborted attempts. They cannot serve as a complete-profile denominator, and completed exposures do not establish uniform dose or unique observers.

safety_ascertainment.active: Visual assessment and monitoring for DCS signs or symptoms in both roles during flight and through the one-hour post-flight observation period.
safety_ascertainment.after_release: Instructed to notify and report to a local hospital if symptoms appeared within 24 hours. Completeness of passive follow-up is unknown.
safety_ascertainment.zero_scope: The narrative reports zero signs or symptoms for both roles in flight, immediately after flight and within 24 hours. It gives no session-by-session ascertainment or separate counts for aborted and completed profiles.

observations.note: Source-reported safety zero. The 12 completed participant exposures are contextual. The report does not give an explicit DCS ascertainment denominator by completion status.
Source-reported safety zero. The 12 completed observer exposures are contextual. Some observers repeated, and the report does not give an explicit DCS ascertainment denominator by completion status.
